name: AM Facial Moisturising Lotion SPF 50
description: CeraVe AM Facial Moisturising Lotion SPF50 is a daily lightweight facial moisturiser, with SPF 50+ UVB/UVA protection, hyaluronic acid and 3 essential ceramides, helping to protect the skin’s natural barrier and leave skin feeling soothed and hydrated for up to 24 hours.
